basic_details.job_title: CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Associate I, Project Assistant II Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR Central Salt & Marine Chemicals Research Institute (CSIR CSMCRI) has announced 3 total vacancies for Project Associate I / Project Assistant II posts on a project-based and purely temporary basis. The positions carry a pay of Rs. 31,000 + HRA for Project Associate I and Rs. 20,000 + HRA for Project Assistant II, with qualifications varying by post. Eligible candidates must send their completed application forms by email on or before 21 October 2026. Final semester or year students awaiting results are not eligible to apply. Affix a recent passport-size photograph to the application form.
Ensure the application form is signed.
Send the completed application form in all respects along with all documents, certificates, and mark sheets by email to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: House Rent Allowance or HRA payable shall be admissible as per the extant Government of India rules as applicable to CSIR employees. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and engagement shall not exceed 06 years in any case.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill out the prescribed application template available on the institute website. Affix a recent passport-size photograph to the application form. Ensure the application form is signed. Send the completed application form in all respects along with all documents, certificates, and mark sheets by email to [email protected] . Complete the submission on or before 21st October 2026 . No hard copy is required to be sent to the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. If a large number of candidates turn up, the candidates will be shortlisted for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee, and the final decision to allow a candidate to appear for an interview rests with the Director, CSIR–CSMCRI. Details regarding the interview (online/offline mode) and interview date shall be communicated to shortlisted candidates through email only.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: House Rent Allowance or HRA payable shall be admissible as per the extant Government of India rules as applicable to CSIR employees.

faq.question: Q3. Are final year students eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, final semester or year students awaiting results are not eligible for consideration.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on criteria fixed by the Selection Committee, and details regarding the interview will be communicated through email only.
